name: Job Finder AI
category: Tailored job search and application suite
description: An AI-powered platform that finds relevant roles, analyzes your resume, and creates tailored application materials — cover letters, CV suggestions, match scores, and LinkedIn Easy Apply automation.

server.deploy: GitHub Actions on push to master (git pull + docker compose up -d --build); backend/.env written from the BACKEND_ENV_FILE secret before each build
server.persistentData: backend/data/ (TinyDB db.json, LinkedIn browser sessions, logs/app.log) — Docker-volume-mounted, survives redeploys

name: Media Checker
category: Photo and video date auditing tool
description: Scans a photo/video library and predicts which date Google Photos will sort each file under, flagging files with missing or mismatched EXIF dates before upload. Reads camera/lens details, exposure settings, resolution, and GPS location where available.

server.deploy: GitHub Actions on push to master (git pull or first-time git clone, then docker compose up -d --build)
server.persistentData: none - stateless; uploads are scanned into a temp folder and discarded after each request

name: SahamYar
category: Multi-broker portfolio and market analysis dashboard
description: Reads portfolio and market data across brokerages (Mofid, Avanza) into one dashboard, with momentum/rebound signal generation and a manual-confirm trading flow for Avanza that requires an explicit Confirm click per order — no automated order placement.

server.deploy: GitHub Actions on push to main (git pull or first-time git clone, then docker compose up -d --build)
server.persistentData: data/ (SQLite DB, Mofid/Avanza Playwright session state) — Docker-volume-mounted, survives redeploys; session files are seeded from an interactive local login since the server can't solve login captchas itself

name: DupliCompare
category: Cross-platform folder comparison and duplicate finder
description: A free, cross-platform GUI app that compares two folders recursively by file name and size and generates an HTML diff report, and scans any folder for duplicate files (by size + MD5 content hash) letting you review each duplicate group side by side — delete, rename, or move any copy right from the app.

server.deploy: GitHub Actions on push to main deploys the landing page to Firebase Hosting (site duplicompare); pushing a version tag (v*.*.*) builds and publishes the Windows/macOS/Linux executables to a GitHub Release
server.persistentData: none - static landing page; app itself is a standalone desktop executable, no server-side state

name: Disk Recovery Tool
category: Failing-disk imaging and exFAT file recovery toolchain
description: A free, open-source toolchain for imaging a damaged/failing disk sector by sector with retries and resume, then recovering exFAT files by parsing filesystem metadata directly (original names and folders, including deleted files), with signature-based carving as a fallback. A cross-platform GUI wraps the pipeline for Windows, macOS and Linux.

server.deploy: GitHub Actions on push to main deploys the landing page via GitHub Pages; the same push bumps a patch version tag and publishes the Windows/macOS/Linux GUI executables to a GitHub Release
server.persistentData: none - static landing page; the GUI is a standalone executable driving the recovery CLIs, no server-side state

name: Media Downloader
description: Downloads video, audio, and photo posts from any yt-dlp-supported link (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, and hundreds more) and delivers the file via a browser, a Telegram bot, or a WhatsApp group — with a multi-user WhatsApp sender where each visitor links their own account.

server.deploy: GitHub Actions on push to main (git pull or first-time git clone via a short-lived GitHub App installation token, then docker compose up -d --build)
server.persistentData: runtime/sender/ (WhatsApp Baileys sessions + per-session contacts, one per linked browser) — Docker-volume-mounted, survives redeploys
